normal.zh_CN: 坂口医生，血压在往下掉。
normal.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the blood pressure is dropping.

normal.zh_CN: 血压还在降，趋势没有停。
normal.en: The blood pressure is still falling. The trend has not stopped.

severe.en: The blood pressure is dropping fast!

normal.en: The blood pressure has suddenly risen!

normal.zh_CN: 坂口医生，血压比刚才高了不少。
normal.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the blood pressure is much higher than before.

severe.en: The blood pressure is still climbing!

normal.en: The heart rate has increased, Doctor Sakaguchi.
The heart rate is still rising.

severe.en: The heart rate is rising too quickly!

normal.zh_CN: 坂口医生，心跳越来越慢。
normal.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the heartbeat is getting slower.
The rhythm on the monitor is irregular.
Doctor Sakaguchi, the rhythm has changed.
Oxygen saturation is falling, Doctor Sakaguchi.

normal.zh_CN: 呼吸状态有变化，我在看监护。
normal.en: The respiratory status has changed. I am watching the monitor.
Respiration is less stable than before.

severe.zh_CN: 呼吸状态突然变得很不稳！
severe.en: Respiratory status has suddenly become very unstable!

normal.zh_CN: 坂口医生，监护状态不太对。
normal.en: Doctor Sakaguchi, the monitor readings do not look right.

severe.en: The monitoring readings have suddenly become unstable!

script_zh_CN.speaker: 岩崎留美
script_zh_CN.text: 哇，天台的风真舒服。护士站待久了，出来一下脑子都清醒了。

script_zh_CN.speaker: 岩崎留美
script_zh_CN.text: 忙呀。不过休息几分钟又不会把病房搬走。医生也别一直绷着嘛。

script_zh_CN.speaker: 岩崎留美
script_zh_CN.text: 明明只想约大家喝杯东西，结果排班一对，能来的就剩两个人。

script_zh_CN.speaker: 岩崎留美
script_zh_CN.text: 两个人也能喝啊。总不能为了凑热闹，连想见谁都忘了。

script_zh_CN.speaker: 岩崎留美
script_zh_CN.text: 栞最近说，周末想自己决定去哪儿。我一开始差点就替她把地点定了。

script_zh_CN.speaker: 岩崎留美
script_zh_CN.text: 后来我问她呀。她想去的地方还挺不错的，害我白操心。
